module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Sub-Account Margin Requirement Pre-Trade Check
precondition: Master prepares to place 5.0 lots EURUSD; Acc #2 has $50 free margin.
expected_result: Flags Acc #2 before execution; skips or trims Acc #2 order to prevent immediate post-fill stop-out.
actual_result: Pre-trade margin validator calculates post-execution margin level, dropping tickets that would cause immediate liquidation.
